title: Repair a number stored as text
prompt: The supplied `opening` and `change` are the coins in a jar and the coins just added. The starter should keep a numeric variable called `count` and add the new coins. Read its diagnostic, repair it, then save. The final value must be a number even when no coins are added.
hints: Read the line number first. Which line gave count its starting type?
Quotation marks make text. The characters inside quotes do not read a variable.
Start from the supplied numeric opening count. Then add the supplied change.

wrongAnswers.misconception: Keeps a text initializer and assigns a number.
Discards the coins already in the jar.

feedback: Trace the first value assigned to count and check the resulting number includes both inputs.
